payload.core_mechanism_summary: Process characters from 'z' down to 'b'; repeatedly remove any instance if it has an adjacent character equal to its immediate predecessor in the alphabet.
payload.rationale: The outer loop establishes a greedy order: larger letters are removed first because they can only be removed with smaller neighbors, and their removal doesn't prevent later removal of smaller letters. The inner repeated scan greedily removes all removable instances of the current letter, which is optimal by exchange argument.
